description: Audit of Development Regression expected secondaryActions against Phase 6C.4 semantic contract.
contract: secondaryActions = explicit orthogonal additional requested work only. NOT: risk, domain context, nouns, verification needs, primary duplication.

cases.prompt: Implement a Stripe webhook endpoint with signature validation and regression tests
cases.rationale: 'regression tests' explicitly requested (orthogonal test work); 'security' from 'signature validation' domain noun/risk, not explicit additional security review/audit

cases.prompt: The test suite fails intermittently with 'Connection refused' errors. Find the root cause and fix it.
cases.rationale: 'test' from 'test suite' domain noun context, not explicit 'and add tests'; 'fix' is part of same repair workflow as 'find root cause'

cases.prompt: Review this auth diff specifically for authorization vulnerabilities
cases.rationale: Primary action is review; secondary 'review' duplicates primary capability

cases.prompt: Review this code only, do not change anything
cases.rationale: Primary action is review; secondary 'review' duplicates primary capability

cases.prompt: Plan the migration to React Native 0.xx, don't implement it yet
cases.rationale: 'upgrade' from 'migration' domain noun; primary is plan with no-implement constraint; upgrade not explicitly requested as additional work

cases.prompt: Upgrade React Native and add regression tests
cases.rationale: 'add regression tests' explicitly requested as orthogonal test work alongside upgrade

cases.prompt: Prepare deployment steps only; do not deploy
cases.rationale: 'deploy' from 'deployment' noun in 'prepare deployment steps'; primary is plan with no-deploy constraint; deploy explicitly negated

cases.prompt: Review this webhook for security issues
cases.rationale: Primary action is review; 'security' and 'test' from domain/risk context, not explicit additional work. No secondary instructions in prompt.

cases.prompt: Implement webhook signature verification and add tests
cases.rationale: 'add tests' explicitly requested; 'security' from 'signature verification' domain noun/risk, not explicit additional security review/audit

cases.prompt: Create a QA regression matrix, don't write automated tests
cases.rationale: Primary action is test (QA matrix creation); secondary 'quality' duplicates primary capability (QA assessment)
'review' from 'audit' synonym; primary is assess (audit); 'review' is same capability as primary assess/audit, not orthogonal additional work
'git' inferred from 'locally' + 'don't push' context; primary is fix; git operations are implied constraints, not explicit additional git work requested

cases.prompt: Review this auth code but do not change anything
cases.rationale: Primary action is review; secondary 'review' duplicates primary capability

cases.prompt: Upgrade React Native and add regression tests
cases.rationale: 'add regression tests' explicitly requested as orthogonal test work alongside upgrade

cases.prompt: Implement Stripe webhook signature verification and add tests and security review
cases.rationale: Both 'security review' and 'add tests' explicitly requested as orthogonal additional work

cases.prompt: Plan rollback for migration with zero downtime health and recovery
cases.rationale: 'deploy' from 'rollback' domain noun; primary is plan; rollback planning is not explicit deploy work

cases.prompt: Implement OAuth login according to approved acceptance criteria
cases.rationale: 'security' from OAuth/auth domain risk; not explicit 'and perform security review/audit'; primary is implement with defined behavior
